title: Pest Control Workers
description: Apply or release chemical solutions or toxic gases and set traps to kill or remove pests and vermin that infest buildings and surrounding areas.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Log work hours and activities into systems

tasks.text: Clean work site after completion of job.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Facility cleaning requires physical manipulation

tasks.text: Measure area dimensions requiring treatment, calculate fumigant requirements, and estimate cost for service.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintenance cost estimation from specs

dwas.name: Estimate maintenance service requirements or costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Spray or dust chemical solutions, powders, or gases into rooms, onto clothing, furnishings, or wood, or over marshlands, ditches, or catch basins.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Treating greenery is physical application work

dwas.name: Treat greenery or surfaces with protective substances.

tasks.text: Recommend treatment and prevention methods for pest problems to clients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Inspect premises to identify infestation source and extent of damage to property, wall, or roof porosity and access to infested locations.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Grounds/building condition assessment is physical

dwas.name: Inspect buildings or grounds to determine condition.

tasks.text: Drive truck equipped with power spraying equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles at work sites is situated mobility

dwas.name: Drive trucks or other vehicles to or at work sites.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Direct, or assist other workers in, treatment or extermination processes to eliminate or control rodents, insects, or weeds.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Supervising maintenance workers is live, accountable leadership

tasks.text: Study preliminary reports or diagrams of infested area and determine treatment type required to eliminate and prevent recurrence of infestation.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Evaluate reports and designs, human owns decisions

dwas.name: Evaluate reports or designs to determine work needs.

tasks.text: Cut or bore openings in building or surrounding concrete, access infested areas, insert nozzle, and inject pesticide to impregnate ground.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pest treatment requires applying chemicals in the field

tasks.text: Post warning signs and lock building doors to secure area to be fumigated.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency notification needs live accountable delivery

dwas.name: Block physical access to restricted areas.
Notify others of emergencies, problems, or hazards.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Set mechanical traps, or place poisonous paste or bait in sewers, burrows, or ditches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pest treatment requires applying chemicals in the field

tasks.text: Clean and remove blockages from infested areas to facilitate spraying procedures and provide drainage, using brooms, mops, shovels, or rakes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pest treatment requires applying chemicals in the field

tasks.text: Position and fasten edges of tarpaulins over building, and tape vents to ensure air-tight environment and to check for leaks.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installation inspection requires on-site physical check

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper installation.
Apply protective coverings to objects or surfaces near work areas.

emerging_tasks.task: Monitor inventory of chemicals and supplies.
